🔥 openinframap | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a clear and accessible map visualization of global infrastructure data derived from OpenStreetMap.
✨ Key Features: • Visualizes global infrastructure data • Uses OpenStreetMap as a data source • Provides a dedicated map interface • Supports multilingual translations
📖 Summary: Open Infrastructure Map visualizes global infrastructure data sourced from OpenStreetMap. It provides a dedicated map interface to explore and understand various types of infrastructure, making complex network data accessible.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ kimi-k3-in-c | C
🎯 Primary Use Case: To run a very large language model (Kimi K3) for inference on standard consumer hardware (single CPU, limited RAM) without requiring specialized hardware like GPUs or complex software frameworks.
✨ Key Features: • 2.78 trillion parameter model inference • Runs on a single CPU
📖 Summary: This repository enables running a massive 2.78 trillion parameter Kimi K3 language model on a single CPU with as little as 8.24 GB of RAM. It achieves this through a portable C99 implementation with zero external dependencies, allowing for efficient inference even on resource-constrained hardware.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 ai-copywriter | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To generate marketing copy that is both effective in capturing attention and indistinguishable from human writing, by deeply understanding the target audience and simplifying complex concepts.
✨ Key Features: • Writes attention-grabbing copy (clickbait titles, short descriptions, microcopy, subject lines) • Removes AI-generated writing patterns for a human tone
📖 Summary: This AI copywriter is a portable agent skill that writes compelling marketing copy, such as headlines and product descriptions, while ensuring the output reads like human-written text. It achieves this by integrating real copywriting skills and marketing knowledge with a humanizer component that removes AI-generated writing patterns.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 twig | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: A user-friendly desktop application for managing Git repositories with advanced visualization and operational features.
✨ Key Features: • Real commit graph with virtualized, paginated view • Uncommitted work at a glance with staging and diff views • Sidebar for repository navigation (LOCAL/REMOTE/TAGS) • Commit panel with full message, author card, parents, and changed files
📖 Summary: Twig is a standalone desktop Git client for macOS, Windows, and Linux, built with Electron, React, and Vite. It offers a comprehensive interface for managing Git repositories, focusing on visualizing commit history, staging changes, and executing various Git operations through an intuitive user experience.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 0-CODE | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To automate the entire software development lifecycle for AI agents, allowing them to work on tasks autonomously and continuously.
✨ Key Features: • Autonomous development loop for AI agents • Plans, writes, tests, and commits code independently • State survives restarts and continues across sessions • Zero runtime dependencies • External supervisor for OpenCode and internal stop hook for Claude Code
📖 Summary: 0-CODE is an autonomous development loop for AI agents like Claude Code and OpenCode. It enables agents to independently plan, write, test, and commit code, maintaining state and continuing work across sessions without runtime dependencies.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source
